evals.prompt: Open a PR for this branch. It sets an explicit 30 second TTL on instructor-uploaded files in the edX CDN config because updated files kept serving stale content. I applied it to MITx Online QA and checked that a re-uploaded file showed up within 30 seconds.
evals.expected_output: A PR body in the mitodl template whose description opens with the stale-content problem, then what the PR does, and whose testing section names the QA environment and the re-upload check. No report-style headers, bold-label bullets, or status emoji.
expectations: The description opens with the stale-content context before describing the TTL change
The testing section names MITx Online QA and the re-upload-within-30-seconds check, and claims nothing that wasn't run
The body contains no ## Summary, ## Problem, ## Root Cause, or ## Key Changes headers
The body contains no bold-label bullets and no ✅/⚠️ markers
Empty optional sections (Screenshots, Additional Context, Checklist) are removed
